<STBG 8,3><BGM 0,0,505><CHAR 3,1,25,0,0><CV 23,16><TALK 3><NAME 33>The wind... is undulating...
That <COL C70101FF>≪Crystal≫</COL>... Nef-Garmat...?

No... something is different...
a red radiance...

The Isles are... nearly breaking...
such power...

Will you go...?
It may be dangerous...

<CV 23,38>...Perhaps
I faintly remember...
a tale told among a distant tribe...

「The crystal dragon... in the earth
it devours... the sky-crystal
dragon descends」

「Its form... shines like the sun...
when it appears... the wind undulates...
and grants the earth great power...」

<CV 23,20>A being of far too many mysteries...
Please... do take care...
